angle: Missed higher-value pass inside the box: Segun Okafor chose a lower-value option over Kwabena Asante with a negative DVA that left Harbourside Rovers chasing a better chance.

explanation.why_it_matters: Okafor, inside the box, picked a lower-value pass (DVA -0.0373) instead of Kwabena Asante, whose option had value 0.0471 and success_prob 0.534, leaving the chance incomplete. With the score NBR 3 - HRV 1 and Chaos Index 16 (control), Harbourside lost a clearer route to pull one back.

en.headline: Missed sitter for Harbourside
en.body: Segun Okafor had a better pass available to Kwabena Asante but chose a lower-value option. The chance ended incomplete and Harbourside stay behind.

it.headline: Occasione clamorosa sprecata per l'Harbourside
it.body: Segun Okafor aveva un passaggio migliore per Kwabena Asante ma ha scelto un'opzione di minor valore. L'occasione si è chiusa senza esito e l'Harbourside resta indietro.

es.headline: Ocasión marrada para Harbourside
es.body: Segun Okafor tenía un pase mejor disponible a Kwabena Asante pero eligió una opción de menos valor. La oportunidad quedó incompleta y Harbourside se quedan por detrás.
